name: A migration map with no chains and no loops
gscNote: Page indexing reports Page with redirect as a neutral status. It does not distinguish one clean hop from a four-hop chain, and it says nothing at all about a loop until the pages start dropping out.
manualCheck: Run every source URL through curl and count the hops to a 200. Do it after deployment, not against the map, because the server, the CDN and the platform each add rules of their own that the map does not know about.
